summary.en: There are phone counters where you can ask about working conditions in a foreign language. This app does not judge whether a specific case is an unfair dismissal. Ask at the counter (to be checked). A dismissal without an objectively reasonable cause that is not socially appropriate is invalid. Even when dismissal is unavoidable, the employer gives 30 days notice or pays at least 30 days of average wages (with exceptions) (to be checked).
